from pathlib import Path

with tarfile.open(root/'baseline.tar') as t:

cache=(current/'CMakeCache.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

env=os.environ.copy();env['CCACHE_DIR']=str(repo/'build/.ccache');env['PATH']=str(Path(value('CMAKE_C_COMPILER')).parent)+os.pathsep+env['PATH']
